🎯 Intent: Default color for all background, areas and surfaces that have no further special definition.
🚫 Not for: Overlays (use Modal Background) or emphasized blocks (use Secondary or Inversed).
♿ Accessibility: ✅ Content Primary, Secondary, Highlight, Success, Error · ⚠️ large text only: Content Warning (light)
📝 Other:

🎯 Intent: Subtle tinted background that separates groups of content from Background/Primary. Also standard surface color for interactive elements that lay on Background/Primary and have no further a shade or a border 
🚫 Not for: Interaction feedback (use Hover) or high-contrast blocks (use Inversed).
♿ Accessibility: ✅ Content Primary, Secondary, Highlight · ⚠️ large text only: Content Success (light), Error (dark), Warning · Fill of an interactive element below 3:1 on Background/Primary: add a border or a clear label
📝 Other:

🎯 Intent: High-contrast block with Content/Inversed on top.
🚫 Not for: Designing in dark mode

🎯 Intent: Default thin line for dividers and for the outline of cards, teasers and interactive elements in their resting state.

♿ Accessibility: ❌ Outline of an interactive element below 3:1 on all Backgrounds except Inversed (light).

🎯 Intent: Quieter line than Primary, for subtle dividers and separations inside dense areas.
